breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt specified both Dirichlet and Periodic boundary conditions, which are contradictory. The ground truth removed the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only includes the Dirichlet boundary condition ('Apply zero Dirichlet boundary conditions on all four edges'), thus resolving the inconsistency.
